# Bundled TOML parser

`smol-toml/index.cjs` is the unmodified CommonJS distribution of smol-toml 1.9.0, bundled so installed plugins work without running `npm install`. Its BSD-3-Clause license is included alongside it.

Source: https://github.com/squirrelchat/smol-toml

The parser validates the configuration before and after editing. The setup helper changes only the status-line assignment and retains unrelated text and comments.
